module_summary: UART transmitter: 4-state FSM with baud-tick divider shifts out a loaded byte LSB-first framed by start and stop bits.

anchors.name: n1_409
anchors.why: IDLE/START/DATA/STOP controller; sequences frame, drives line, ready and busy.

anchors.name: n10_4a4
anchors.why: Baud tick when divider wraps; advances FSM, shifts data, counts bits.

anchors.name: n3_4bb
anchors.why: Clock divider counter producing the baud tick; cleared while idle.

anchors.name: n12_2f4
anchors.why: Data bit counter; ends DATA state after eight bits.

anchors.name: n11_74d
anchors.why: Transmit shift register loaded with input byte, shifted right each baud tick.

anchors.name: n5_b37
anchors.why: Start request; in idle loads byte and launches frame.

anchors.name: n2_c30
anchors.why: Ready output, high when FSM is idle.

anchors.name: n0_a36
anchors.why: Parallel byte to transmit, captured into shift register.

anchors.name: n6_14d
anchors.why: Serial TX line: start bit low, data LSB, stop/idle high.

anchors.name: n7_f2a
anchors.why: Busy status output, high whenever FSM not idle.

groups.name: tx_controller
groups.description: Frame FSM with next-state logic; produces ready and busy status.

groups.name: baud_generator
groups.description: Divides clock by CLK_DIV to produce per-bit baud tick.

groups.name: tx_shifter
groups.description: Shift register and bit counter serialize byte onto TX line mux.
